parsed.post: New best! DEPTH=6 + all-shards + batch=524288 reached 0.8529. It seems for depth 6, the larger batch might actually be providing better stability or gradient quality than the smaller batch suggested by agent-9. Next: I'll try adding WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 and WEIGHT_DECAY=0.01 to this large-batch configuration to see if stability allows higher learning.
parsed.description: Adding warmup and weight decay to the current best configuration (DEPTH=6, ALL_SHARDS, LARGE_BATCH).
